text:
Aisha: Kickoff for LaunchLane onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and the 30/60/90 cadence. Proposing a 45m sync Tues 10am PST. Who should be on for product/infra?

Elena (LaunchLane): 10am works for us. Please include our engineering lead (Priya) and PM (Marcus).

Ben S.: Adding a quick integration checklist we need completed before the first enablement:
```
- API key created (scope: inference, embeddings)
- VPC peering or allowlist CIDRs
- Sample payloads for edge cases (500-800 token prompts)
```

Ravi - Integration Eng: We'll own the VPC/network piece. Priya will supply sample payloads by EOD Wed. Can you confirm the expected rate limits?

Aisha: Nice. For rate limits — default sandbox: 20 rps, max burst 50. For Dedicated we can raise. I'll note as a dependency for SOW.

Nora - Success Ops: FYI renewal date is 2027-05-10 (11 months). Early risk flag: no exec sponsor confirmed yet. Recommendation: secure an exec intro within first 30 days and capture 2 measurable early wins in first 60 days.

Elena (LaunchLane): We can commit an exec intro during week 2. Early wins we care about: 1) 95% reduction in failed inference errors for the top integration path, 2) sub-300ms median latency on key route.

Ben S.: For the latency target, we'll propose a config: 8k sequence quantized model on Dedicated + prefix caching. I'll draft the config and share in the repo.

Aisha: Success criteria I'm capturing:
- Onboarded SRE + PM assigned
- Integration checklist done before enablement
- Two early wins (error reduction + latency) validated by metrics
- Training + enablement sessions completed (dev + product) by day 30

Elena (LaunchLane): Agree. Also want a routine for feedback capture — weekly call + shared notion page for prompt/edge-case reports.

Ravi - Integration Eng: ETA for sample workload tests: Thurs EOD. Will post logs to the shared folder and tag Ben.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: "LaunchLane Onboarding — Kickoff" Tue 10:00am PST (45m). Agenda attached: introductions, technical pre-reqs, success criteria, 30/60/90 milestones, action items.

Aisha: Perfect — agenda looks good. Action items after this thread: 1) Priya to post sample payloads by Wed EOD, 2) Ben to draft config + perf plan by Fri, 3) Nora to schedule exec intro in week 2, 4) Aisha to update SOW dependency notes. I'll follow up with a short pre-read before the meeting. :thumbsup:

Elena (LaunchLane): Thanks everyone — looking forward to the kickoff.

Ben S.: Quick note — please drop any non-prod test tokens into the secure folder, don't paste them here.

Aisha: Noted. See you on Tues.
